title: Clipboard: copy/cut/paste/paste-in-place
description: Flash 8 Edit menu clipboard ops missing entirely. Implement: (1) Ctrl+C copies selected display objects as JSON to the clipboard (use navigator.clipboard.writeText with a well-known prefix so it only pastes within the app); (2) Ctrl+X cuts (copy then delete); (3) Ctrl+V pastes at cursor or offset +10/+10 from original; (4) Ctrl+Shift+V paste-in-place (exact same position); (5) Edit > Duplicate (Ctrl+D) duplicates in-place with +10/+10 offset and selects the duplicate. All ops go through pushDoc for undo. Wire to both keyboard handlers (StageArea useEffect) and Edit menu (MenuBar). See docs/04-toolbox.md.
